- **Open-loop observations hurt a lot.** The observation is frozen at the attempt's start cell; per-step BFS + dx, dy feedback still runs. BC-fail test pairs: STk0 0.16 → STk7 0.32, vs 0.39 → 0.60 for closed-loop observations. Control drops too: 0.59 → 0.86 vs 0.93 → 0.98. dx, dy still give away the current cell, so the gap is not missing state information. The policy uses the observation image itself to act.

- **DAgger relabelling matches the A\* demo target.** Here the BFS expert labels every cell of the policy's own last attempt, after n unsupervised attempts in context. BC-fail test pairs: STk0 0.40 → STk7 0.60, the same as the demo-supervised run (0.39 → 0.60). Control ends at 0.98 for both. From round 2 on, the policy solves 95–100% of training starts during collection. The relabelled states then mostly lie on near-optimal paths, so the expert adds little that the demos lacked.

- **Context within an attempt sequence (50 test pairs).** STk7 perf@n is flat or falling for the A\* target (0.66 → 0.60) and open-loop runs (0.40 → 0.32). It rises only for relabel (0.54 → 0.60). Best-of-n gains come from diversity plus the verifier.

- **BC retrained on the DAgger data does not help.** That data is 642 expert rollouts plus the expert path from each of 66,160 learner-visited states: 66,802 episodes covering 1,616 unique (cell, train goal) pairs. On BC-fail test pairs it scores 0.01 open loop, 0.135 re-planned (h64) and 0.03 re-planned (h4). Original BC scored 0.00 / 0.03 / 0.06. On all 2870 held-out pairs: 0.43 / 0.45 / 0.40, vs 0.43 / 0.45 / 0.46. On control it is slightly worse (0.79–0.86 vs 0.86–0.97). More expert labels from training goals do not move BC on held-out goals, so the expert's coverage is not BC's limit. Whatever ST's training changes (per-step feedback tokens, its own rollouts as inputs), BC on (obs → expert action) pairs does not get it.
The open-loop run is better than BC on BC-fail pairs but loses on pairs BC solves (0.86 vs 0.98).

- **Relabel is the only run where the attempt after k own attempts beats attempt 1 with no context.** On BC-fail pairs, k = 2…7: +0.06 to +0.12, e.g. 0.69 vs 0.62 at k = 7. For the A\* target it is 0 to −0.09. This gap mostly reflects how relabel trains, not a gain over the A\* target. After round 0, relabel only trains the attempt that follows n own attempts, so attempt 1 is no longer supervised. Its attempt 1 (0.62) sits below the A\* target's (0.72). Its attempt 8 (0.69) only gets back to about the A\* target's attempt-1 level, and to STk0 trained 7200 steps (0.72). The model does use its context, but here context only recovers what the training format costs.
